title: Meta hit with $25B fine in New Mexico
description: The 2018 Cambridge Analytica scandal was one of the largest user data breaches in history and its repercussions for Meta are still felt to this day. Following a two-week trial, a jury in the State District Court in Santa Fe ruled that Meta had committed 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws. Each violation was assessed to carry up to $5,000 in penalty charges, leading to the $25 billion fine that Meta is now ordered to pay the state of New Mexico. This is the largest fine against the company to date. To put that number into perspective, Meta made an estimated $42.6...

description: Epic Games’ legal battle against Apple just notched another victory, this time in Australia. title: Spotify launches podcast Memberships, creators keep 90% of the revenue
description: Spotify first previewed Memberships at its Investor Day back in May, and today the feature is rolling out in 34 markets. It lets eligible podcast creators charge their biggest fans a monthly fee for exclusive content and perks, and it replaces the podcast subscriptions Spotify introduced in 2021. Creators get to decide what their Membership includes: exclusive audio or video, bonus episodes, fewer ads, early access, access to a show's archive, or all of the above. They can also split their benefits into up to three tiers, each with its own price. Spotify isn't setting prices itself, though...
